notes.title: Aeon Drive Update #3: Major overhaul to player mobility + bug fixes
notes.notes:
We meet again, Neo Barcelona visitors!

A [b]new patch[/b] just went live featuring several [b]bug fixes[/b] and improvements to the [b]mobility[/b] and [b]responsiveness[/b]. This patch was created with the help of our speedrunning community feedback, so the game should feel and play better than ever!


[u]Here’s a list of the main changes:[/u]

[list]
[*] Time will no longer stop when pausing on respawn
[*] Jack will no longer face a different direction when attacking/throwing dagger while idle
[*] Levels beat using wall glitches will no longer count towards the leaderboards
[*] Fixed landing animation delay and input bug
[*] Fixed bug that prevented players from teleporting to the dagger while slashing
[*] Added input buffers
[*] Ground pound animation can now be canceled
[*] Wall jump is improved and should feel more responsive now
[*] Grabbing a diamond while in co-op mode will now correctly show in the level report
[*] Fixed bug that would show all save slots with 100% collectibles unlocked
[*] Fixed end of tutorial game crash
[*] Added button remap localization
[*] Overall polish of animations and inputs
[/list]
[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/XS9l422RUqz5OtqUG1/giphy.gif?cid=790b76110c9290fe6aeb8412a60ce3dbffdb5dbec95aa446&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

As always, thank you for all the support that you have shown, and we hope you continue to have fun with Aeon Drive.

For feedback and/or bug reports, feel free to join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/K955a5nt5j]Discord[/url][/b].

[url=https://discord.gg/K955a5nt5j][img]https://i.imgur.com/icHFk6n.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Aeon Drive Update #2: Bug fixes + improvements
notes.notes:
Hello Neo Barcelona visitors!

A [b]new patch[/b] just went live featuring [b]bug fixes[/b] and [b]general improvements[/b] to the UI, menus and gameplay. 


[u]Here’s a list of the main changes:[/u]

[list]
[*] Faster respawns and level reload times
[*] Fixed the screen controls bug
[*] Fixed the resolution bug
[*] Fixed collectibles bug when changing language
[*] Fixed the bug where the the player would lose control of Jack and the timer would stop
[*] Fixed the bug where the 4th player in co-op would get stuck inside the wall 
[*] Fixed the bug where the player couldn't progress in the tutorial
[*] Updated fonts and backdrops in the tutorial and new cutscenes
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Aeon Drive Update: Bug fixes + improvements
notes.notes:
Hello Neo Barcelona visitors!

A [b]new patch[/b] just went live featuring [b]bug fixes[/b] and [b]general improvements[/b] to the UI, menus and gameplay. 


[u]Here’s a list of the main changes:[/u]

[list]
[*] Collectible information (gems, hotdogs, data cubes and number of time capsules used) will now correctly display on the save slot, sector selection and level section.
[*] Tutorial improvements.
[*] Confirmation step when deleting a save slot.
[*] Twitter video replay sharing system re-implemented.
[*] More options: disabling vibration, screenshake and countdown at the start of a level.
[*] Remapping is no longer in playerprefs (this will solve the crashing issues some players were experiencing).
[*] In-game bug fixes: fixed camera boundaries, fixed the bug where sliding and pausing the game would cause the timer to stop.
[/list]

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/PLv1wViBdcT8Po6HyB/giphy.gif?cid=790b7611044629f1732e02a47e68b6003f4400e16fb96710&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

notes.title: It’s Release Day!
notes.notes:
Today is September 30th, which means Aeon Drive finally releases on Steam and other major platforms. We want to thank our fans and everyone who supported us and kept an eye on our project along the way. It really means the world! However, this is just the beginning, as now gamers from all around the world will finally be able to compete with each other in a true free-for-fall, as well as enjoy the story and co-op modes. You can also get the game at a 10% discount while you're at it! We are also going to update you on a few other things today, so stay tuned and have fun!

notes.title: Release Date + Aeon Drive Tournament Announcement
notes.notes:
First off, we’re finally ready to reveal the release date:

[b]Aeon Drive will launch on September 30th for PC, Playstation 4 /5, Xbox One, Xbox Series S|X, and Nintendo Switch![/b] 

Make sure to add Aeon Drive to your wishlist, and be the first to play when it launches!

To celebrate the upcoming release, we’re launching [b]Aeon Drive Tournament[/b] - a global free-to-play contest, in collaboration with Elgato and GUNNAR, as well as the Global Speedrunning Association.

[previewyoutube=zuqcqsCe_pE;full][/previewyoutube]

Get an early, exclusive look at Aeon Drive - and compete in the Global Leaderboards with other players to win amazing prizes, including Elgato Wave:3 microphone, GUNNAR Gaming eyewear and even a Nintendo Switch! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38356345/17a3856db4b4472add24a24cadbed1920cad3a9a.png[/img]

Join the race by downloading Aeon Drive Tournament on Steam: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1479150/Aeon_Drive_Tournament/

Winners of the Aeon Drive Tournament will compete in the Tournament Finals, taking on notable speed running streamers such as  in Aeon Drive’s PVP mode, in an event live-streamed on Twitch! 

For more info on prizes, as well as the Terms and Conditions, visit [url=https://www.criticalreflex.com/tournament]aeondrive.gg[/url]  - and don’t delay, the Tournament will be available on Steam until September 15! 

[url=https://discord.gg/arZKZDtjpA][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38356345/4294d235e24333c1304b29792b51fdf560a0023a.gif[/img][/url]

Join the official Discord for the game - and be on the lookout for updates on the Tournament, latest streams and events and daily Discord Nitro Giveaways! 

See you on the streets of Neo Barcelona!
